name: Chatrio
description: Chatrio is a free, anonymous web app that instantly pairs you with a random stranger for a private 1-on-1 text or video chat with a real human — no account, no app download, no phone number, and no bots. It is a modern, browser-based Omegle alternative.
pricing: Free — no subscription, no premium tiers, no hidden costs

products.name: Random Chat
products.description: Anonymous 1-on-1 text chat with a random stranger, optional interest matching, no account required.

products.name: Random Video Chat
products.description: Anonymous 1-on-1 live video chat with a random stranger, no account required.

products.name: Circles
products.description: Anonymous local/nearby chat showing approximate-area presence only, with intro-message gated 1-on-1 chats and local group rooms. No account required.
